scripts.install: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: npm run dev:postgres && concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && set DATABASE_URL=postgresql://ballistic_user:ballistic_pass@localhost:5432/ballistic&& set SECRET_KEY=development_secret_key_change_in_production_32_chars_min&& set CORS_ORIGINS=http://localhost:5173,http://localhost:5174,http://localhost:8000&& python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.migrate: cd backend && set DATABASE_URL=postgresql://ballistic_user:ballistic_pass@localhost:5432/ballistic&& set SECRET_KEY=development_secret_key_change_in_production_32_chars_min&& python -m alembic upgrade head
